        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json,os
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    d=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and grid[0][c]!=0]
    dv=d[0]
    L=[row[:dv] for row in grid]; R=[row[dv+1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if L[r][c]!=0 and R[r][c]!=0 else 0 for c in range(len(L[0]))] for r in range(h)]
